facts.text: The resort sits on 13 acres of private bayfront on the island of Key Largo in the Florida Keys.
facts.excerpt: Located on 13 acres of private bayfront, the resort is located on the island of Key Largo in the Florida Keys.

facts.text: The resort has two waterfall pools and beach hammocks.
facts.excerpt: Our facilities include two waterfall pools and beach hammocks.

facts.text: Water activities offered include diving, parasailing, catamaran sailing and deep-sea fishing.
facts.excerpt: We provide a wide range of water activities including diving, parasailing, catamaran sailing, and deep-sea fishing.

facts.text: There are two beaches: Hammock Beach, which tends to be quiet, and a more active beach for watersports such as kayaking and paddleboarding.
facts.excerpt: There are two beaches: Hammock Beach, which tends to be quiet, and a more active beach where you can try your hand at watersports, from kayaking to paddleboarding (included in the resort fee).

facts.text: The resort is whitewashed and modern, with tall ceilings and walls of windows.
facts.excerpt: Whitewashed and modern, with tall ceilings and walls of windows, Baker’s Cay Resort Key Largo is the epitome of contemporary island style

facts.text: The resort is a member of Hilton's Curio Collection.
facts.excerpt: The resort is a member of Hilton’s Curio Collection.

facts.text: Rooms feature hardwood floors, patterns with coastal elements and sleek, modern bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Rooms feature hardwood floors, vaguely tribal patterns punctuated with coastal elements, and sleek, modern bathrooms.

facts.text: The indoor-outdoor Calusa serves breakfast and dinner with a Caribbean-Creole slant.
facts.excerpt: The indoor-outdoor Calusa does a la carte breakfast and dinner with a Caribbean-Creole slant.

facts.text: A hook-and-cook program lets guests bring their catch from a fishing excursion to the kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The hotel even has a hook-and-cook program; if you get lucky on your fishing excursion, you can bring your catch to the kitchen.

facts.text: The daily resort charge includes bicycles, beach chairs and umbrellas, paddle boards and kayaks, fishing rods with bait, family activities and a daily sunset toast.
facts.excerpt: Daily Resort Charge includes: Internet access; bicycles; beach chairs & umbrellas; paddle boards & kayaks; fishing rods with bait; two water vessels, refillable throughout stay; recreational amenities & equipment; family activities; pool & beach activities/delights; daily sunset toast/ceremony.

facts.excerpt: There’s even a director of pet relations.

facts.text: Key Largo's main drag can be touristy, and the resort is a chic departure from that.
facts.excerpt: Key Largo can be a bit touristy on the main drag—KFC, tacky T-shirt shops, that sort of thing—but this resort is a chic departure from that.

facts.text: Dining includes Creole-Caribbean cuisine with panoramic Florida Bay views and beachside dishes with live music at the cove bar.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Creole‑Caribbean cuisine with panoramic Florida Bay views, along with beachside dishes paired with live music at our cove bar.

facts.text: A daily resort charge of $49 applies per night.
facts.excerpt: **Price includes $49.00 USD** resort charge per night

facts.text: Meeting space includes the Baker Ballroom, the Cayview Ballroom and the Grand Lawn.
facts.excerpt: featuring the Baker Ballroom, and Cayview Ballroom, and the Grand Lawn

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler calls it the epitome of contemporary island style.
facts.excerpt: Full of South Florida elegance, this is the epitome of contemporary island style.
